description: A data sink event of an alert: a run of the data sink keeps failing, or the data sink went to Error. It names the data sink and the run, never a user, a destination or a credential.

attempts.description: Failed attempts of the run at the event.
attempts.title: attempts

backfillID.description: The backfill of the run, for a Backfill run.
backfillID.title: backfillID

dataSinkID.description: The ID of the data sink.
dataSinkID.title: dataSinkID

dataSinkName.description: The name of the data sink.
dataSinkName.title: dataSinkName

dataset.description: The dataset of the run, using the same values as DataSinkRun.dataset.
dataset.title: dataset

kind.description: The kind of the run, using the same values as DataSinkRun.kind.
kind.title: kind

reason.description: The sanitized error of the run.
reason.title: reason

transition.description: Failing (a run keeps failing) or Error (the data sink went to Error).
transition.title: transition

title: AlertDataSinkEvent
